units.source_text: “你给卖到东京去的时候，不是只有他一个人给你送行吗？

en.t: When you were sold off to Tokyo, wasn’t he the only one who came to see you off?

units.source_text: 你最早的日记本开头不就是记他的吗？

en.t: Wasn’t he the one you wrote about at the very beginning of your earliest diary?

units.source_text: 难道有什么理由不去给他送终？

en.t: What reason could there be not to go and see him through his final moments?

units.source_text: 去把你记在他那生命的最后一页上吧。”

en.t: Go and write yourself onto the last page of his life.”
